role: World Health Assembly intergovernmental negotiating group
promise: Conclude the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) annex to the Pandemic Agreement by the 80th World Health Assembly (May 2027)
description: The IGWG held its seventh session July 6-17, 2026. WHO reported further work was needed, with submission planned for the May 2027 Assembly or an earlier special session.
evidence: Deadline extended to the 80th WHA (May 2027) per a UK Parliament written statement
Only one further negotiating session (July 2026) was scheduled as of mid-2026

review.note: Mandate permits submission earlier at a special session, not exclusively WHA80. July session has now occurred and further discussion remained necessary. June 3 is a UK statement publication, not established date of WHO decision; exact end-May cutoff not verified.
